title: Jilla
desc: Shakthi, the adopted son of Sivan, is a powerful gangster in Madurai. Although Shakthi bitterly hates the police, he is forced to become a policeman at his father's behest.

title: Aambala
desc: Three brothers head to their native village to reconcile with their estranged relatives. However, a corrupt politician seeks to cause misunderstandings among them for his selfish interests.

title: Mersal
desc: Maaran, a doctor, is falsely arrested for the murder of his colleague, Dr Arjun Zachariah. He soon discovers that the real culprit is a lookalike who aims to expose corruption in the medical industry.

title: Dada
desc: Manikandan, a young boy, endures many hardships and faces the challenges of raising a son as a single parent after accidentally impregnating his lover.

title: The Game
desc: Detective Seo Joon-Young teams up with Kim Tae-Pyung to resolve a serial killer case using Tae-Pyung's unique ability to predict a person's death.

title: Ee Parakkum Thalika
desc: Unni, a bus owner, tries several ways to improve the condition of his bus, which is named after his late father. Things take a turn when the daughter of a powerful politician enters his life.
